paragraphs.text: Chanto Umezawa (oo-meh-ZAH-wah) was the father of Haki Umezawa and the grandfather of Tetsuo Umezawa . He was a distant descendant of Toshiro Umezawa .

He was a peasant farmer who was called to fight in the Kentsu during a rebellion on the Edemi Islands . After the war, he never fought again but made his fortune by making swords for Kentsu generals and wealthy nobles.
